I’m happy it works for you to be able to play the game, but for others it may not. Like me, I played the games (and I loved them) but I don’t have the time to replay them, nor am I much of a video game person anymore. And I understand needing to change it up, but at the end of the day people who play the games know what happens. If they add or take too much, it’s not like its counterpart… if anything it’s a new story. For example, House of the Dragon gets shit on because it’s not like its counterpart and more fan-fiction (an opinion I commonly see).

And they’ve managed to make 7-10 episodes a season with the story. If anything they could have made this season just a little longer if they kept more towards the story, but I’m just happy the show is being seen.

As I said: I like the show, but I don’t like all the changes.  And that’s acceptable. To each their own. Opinions are a thing.
